mission: Build the ForgeOps 1.0 reusable toolkit (governance, state, testing, hooks, skills, agents) per the operator's mission brief.
completed_work: Phase 0: source audit of TrendForge reusable material - committed 662c101 on master
Phase 1: repository structure and root project files - committed c00b66e on feature/phase1-repository-foundation
Phase 2A: forgeops doctor/status/audit, core infra, detectors, security scanning - committed 64d5596 on feature/phase1-repository-foundation (accepted)

Phase 2B: CLAUDE.md, forgeops changed, forgeops test --targeted (planner + executor), top-level CLI exception handling, hardened forgeops:allow-secret marker - committed 1949145 on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing (accepted)

Phase 2C: forgeops test --full (build_full_test_plan sharing the existing plan/executor model) and forgeops release-check (aggregates doctor/audit/test --full, never reimplements their checks); 300 passing tests, zero regressions - committed 45f52a3 on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing (accepted)

Phase 2C (checkpoint/handoff): forgeops checkpoint (writes .agent/CURRENT_STATE.json) and forgeops handoff (writes .agent/HANDOFF.md, derived from the same deterministic data) - forgeops/state/atomic_write.py and forgeops/state/checkpoint.py new, forgeops/state/schema.py gained SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSIONS; 379 passing tests, zero regressions - committed 4731af7 on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing (accepted)

Phase 2C (process-list/cleanup): forgeops process-list (read-only Windows-native process discovery/classification via PowerShell/CIM + netstat, no psutil) and forgeops cleanup (conservative, dry-run-by-default; only an exact PID+repository+start-time registry match is ever a termination candidate; graceful taskkill only, never force; stale-record removal) - forgeops/state/runtime_registry.py, forgeops/detectors/processes.py, forgeops/detectors/process_association.py new; real disposable-process validation performed (registered a real child process, ran cleanup --execute against it, confirmed graceful-termination-timeout is reported honestly without escalation, force-cleaned the test process manually); 473 passing tests (up from 380), zero regressions - on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing, uncommitted pending review (per this checkpoint's explicit instruction not to create a second commit)

next_action: Phase 2C (test --full + release-check) is committed at 45f52a3, and Phase 2C (checkpoint/handoff) is committed at 4731af7, both on feature/phase2b-targeted-testing. forgeops process-list and forgeops cleanup are implemented, tested (473 passing), and validated by real invocation - including a real disposable-process execute run whose graceful-termination-timeout was reported honestly without escalation - but deliberately left UNCOMMITTED for review per this checkpoint's explicit instruction (do not create a second commit). Do not commit the process-list/cleanup work without Joshua's explicit authorization. Once authorized, review `git status --short` for the new files (forgeops/state/runtime_registry.py, forgeops/detectors/processes.py, forgeops/detectors/process_association.py, forgeops/cli/process_list.py, forgeops/cli/cleanup.py, associated tests and docs) and commit with an appropriate message. Do not begin the next checkpoint (init/agents/worktrees/approvals/MCP/installers/Codex delegation/Rocky integration/business-operation modules, or a force-kill path for cleanup) automatically - all were explicitly out of scope for this bounded checkpoint.
